params.prompt: EDIT IMAGE 1, a packshot of a pair of lilac butterfly stud earrings on a cream plaster cube. Make TWO changes only, on BOTH studs. Keep everything else exactly as it is: the upper-left marquise, the two larger lower pears with their points toward the centre, the tiny gold bead at each centre, the posts, the cube, the camera, the framing, the background and the light. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge. A clean modern digital photograph: no creases, no fold lines, no aged-paper texture, no scratches, no film grain.
